verdict.rationale: IRCC's online services could plausibly offer AI-driven guidance, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack contains nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions. The only related features are the rule-based eligibility questionnaires and a backward-looking processing-time checker. These are adjacent, non-AI features and earn no credit.
